name: Opening Range Breakout
thesis: Momentum out of the first 15-min range tends to continue. Usually a lower-WR breakout play - must prove it fits high-WR / low-RR after costs.
rules: Range = high/low of 9:15-9:30 ET (A) or 9:30-9:45 ET (B), tested separately. Enter on a break of the range high (long) or low (short). Stop at the other side or the middle of the range. Fixed target. Variant: ATR-based stop/target and/or skip days whose range is too wide vs ATR.
